title: Free-Throw Pressure Routine
description: Shooters build and repeat a consistent pre-shot routine from the free-throw line, then test it under simulated fatigue and simple scoreboard pressure.

content.objective: Build one repeatable pre-shot routine and perform it the same way every time, under pressure or not.
content.setup: Shooter sits at the free-throw line with a ball and space to set a routine.
instructions: Choose a simple routine — for example two bounces, a breath, and a spin of the ball.
Perform the exact same routine before every attempt, make or miss.
Shoot sets of ten, tracking makes without changing the routine based on results.
Finish with five free throws right after a short push sprint to test it under fatigue.
coachingPoints: Keep the routine identical regardless of the previous shot's result.
Breathe out just before the release to stay relaxed.
Track progress over time rather than reacting to any single miss.
commonMistakes: Changing the routine after a miss out of frustration.
Rushing the routine when tired instead of trusting it.
Rushing the release instead of trusting the mechanics.
content.safety: Keep the lane clear for a rebounder standing to the side.
